dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.macro_annuli_edge_geometry: Multiple prominent 'O' and 'C' shaped structures located along the dorsal-lateral region with sharp, jagged edge transitions from a low-intensity dark background to a high-intensity light grey interior.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.high_intensity_blob_density: High spatial density of small, asymmetrical dark-pixel clusters concentrated primarily around the neck and lower lateral areas, characterized by solid intensity without internal gradients.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.constellation_keypoints: Centroids of the three largest dorsal annuli form a distinct obtuse triangle; an elongated, slightly curved chain of five smaller 'O' shaped markers extends toward the posterior dorsal section.
